extName.message: Tarjuman — Arabic subtitles & dubbing for any video

extDescription.message: Synced Arabic subtitles and natural live dubbing on YouTube and any video site, powered by the Tarjuman app on your own computer.

cmdToggle.message: Turn translation on or off in this tab

tagline.message: Arabic subtitles & dubbing for any video

offlineBody.message: Tarjuman translates on your own computer, so the app needs to be running. Start it, then open this window again.

offlineHint.message: First time? The guide takes two minutes.

hintProtected.message: Browser pages and extension stores can't be translated.

hintYouTube.message: Captions from YouTube, translated and synced to the video.

hintCaptions.message: The player's own captions, translated and perfectly timed.

hintLive.message: Live from the tab's audio, a few seconds behind the speaker.

hintSite.message: Uses the player's captions when it has them, otherwise the tab's audio.

sessionOnly.message: This works until the page reloads.

btnAllowSite.message: Keep it on for this site

lblDubHint.message: The speaker talks in your language

lblWaitHint.message: Pauses the video a moment instead of cutting speech

optionsIntro.message: Changes apply right away, including to a video that is already being translated.

lblVoiceHint.message: Voices come from the app on your computer

lblVoiceOffline.message: Start the app to choose a voice

lblDuckHint.message: How loud the video stays under the dub

sitesIntro.message: Tarjuman always works on YouTube. On other sites it asks once per site, so translation keeps running when the page reloads. Without that, it still works until a reload.

connOfflineHint.message: Start it on this computer; the extension finds it by itself.

lblServerAddressHint.message: Leave empty to find the app automatically on ports $1. Only addresses on this computer are allowed.

testFail.message: Nothing answered. Is the app running?

aboutBody.message: Tarjuman is free and open source. Everything is processed by the app on your own computer; the extension sends nothing anywhere else.

welcomeLede.message: Synced subtitles and a natural Arabic voice, on YouTube and almost any site. The work happens in the Tarjuman app on your computer, so it needs one minute of setup.

step1Body.message: Tarjuman is free and runs on your own computer. Download it and follow the short install note.

step2Body.message: Run the start script that comes with it, or this command:

step2Note.message: The extension finds it on its own. This page turns green when it does.

step3Body.message: Open a video and click the Tarjuman icon in the toolbar, then “Translate this video”.

step3Keys.message: does the same from the keyboard

modesTitle.message: It picks the best source by itself

welcomePrivacy.message: Your videos and audio go only to your own computer. No account, no analytics.
